root_cause.text: The `bio_integrity_prep` function in the block layer fails to apply the `__GFP_ZERO` flag during allocation of the auto-generated integrity buffer when the metadata size exceeds the protection information tuple size, leaving opaque metadata regions uninitialized.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the conditional check in `block/bio-integrity-auto.c` from `bi->csum_type == BLK_INTEGRITY_CSUM_NONE` to `bi->metadata_size > bi->pi_tuple_size` to enable zeroing, aligning with the CVE description that identifies the uninitialized remainder of the metadata when metadata size is larger than the PI tuple.
